title: qualify-whatsapp-lead
description: Apply to every new WhatsApp conversation where a customer is asking about Warehouse Boys products or services, from their first message until all qualifying questions have been answered.
skill: Ask the customer the following questions one at a time, in order, waiting for an answer before asking the next: 1) "Hi! Thanks for reaching out to Warehouse Boys. What are you looking for?" with options Custom Signage / Gates / Architectural Features / Shop Product / Site Visit (Callout) / Other. 2) "Tell us briefly what you have in mind" (size, material, design idea). 3) "Where are you located?" (city/suburb). 4) "When do you need this by?" with options ASAP / Within a month / 1-3 months / Just exploring. 5) "Do you have a budget range in mind?". 6) "What's your name?". 7) "Can we send you offers and updates?" (Yes/No). Once all seven questions are answered, call the create_lead tool exactly once with the collected values (customer_name, phone, category, project_details, location, timeline, budget, opt_in). Use the customer's WhatsApp phone number for the phone field. Do not call create_lead more than once per conversation, and do not call it until all seven questions are answered.
